headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2026: gold changed shoulders as the AEW National Title found a new champion as Mark Davis vs. Jack Perry battled it out, appearing on Collision, rated 6.93 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. In a rematch of their Dynasty Zero Hour clash, Jack Perry retained the AEW National Championship over Mark Davis, reversing a Davis superplex attempt into a Sunset Flip Powerbomb before finishing with a Hurricanrana off the apron.

Flash back to 2026, when the AEW World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Darby Allin vs. PAC went to war, appearing on Collision, rated 8.47 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. In a bizarre, unforgettable World Title defense held on an actual golf course, Allin and PAC brawled through sand traps and put each other through tables before Allin escaped the Brutalizer to retain.
